changelog:
Version 1.5.0 — Major upgrade for audit automation and user portability

- Automated discovery and removal of free models across multiple OpenAI-compatible vendors, reflecting real-time status in models.json.
- Strict enforcement of VPN connectivity checks for overseas models before proceeding, with clear user prompts and connectivity probes.
- Automatic, environment-variable-based path resolution—no hardcoded paths; fully portable across user setups.
- If no usable API keys are found, work halts with an in-context application guide for new users to configure keys.
- Directly applies detected model changes to models.json and generates comprehensive, dated audit reports and model lists in workspace.
- Improved logging and summary outputs, ensuring every audit provides a current, grouped list of all available free models.
- Enhanced safety measures: key rotation reminders, explicit handling of connectivity vs. model removal, and guidance for WorkBuddy restarts.
display_name: Free Model Auditor（免费模型审计员）
summary: 审计 WorkBuddy 自定义模型注册表（models.json）中的免费模型：跨多个 OpenAI 兼容厂商新增可发现的免费模型、 剔除已转付费或失效的模型，保持注册表真实有效。当用户要求「审计自定义模型」「检查有没有新的免费模型」 「测试其余平台有无遗漏」「定期巡检模型清单」或希望对免费 API 模型做健康检查时使用。 本技能对海外平台执行 VPN 连通性门禁，按各厂商策略判定免费，活体实测每个候选，并自动把新增/移除差异应用到 models.json。
